summary: Tested Phase A-D features: Categories CRUD, Policies CRUD, Quick Add, Contact Page, Trust Signals, Scarcity/Conversion triggers. All 19 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified for all features. Fixed bug in policy_routes.py (wrong permission key 'settings' -> 'platform_settings').

issues: TEST_CATEGORY appears in nav - likely test data that should be cleaned up

action_items: Consider cleaning up TEST_CATEGORY from categories (test data visible in production nav)
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: policy_routes.py was checking 'settings' permission but admin has 'platform_settings' - changed to 'platform_settings'
Categories CRUD fully functional with sub-categories support
Policies CRUD fully functional with markdown-style content rendering
Quick Add button on ProductCard shows quantity controller after adding (Blinkit-style)
Footer has complete trust signals bar with 4 items
Contact page has WhatsApp, Email, Instagram, Phone cards with trust signals
ProductDetailPage has scarcity indicators (conditional) and conversion triggers (Delivery 3-5 days, COD Available)
Admin Categories panel at /admin -> Categories with add/edit/delete functionality
Admin Policies panel at /admin -> Policies with create/edit/publish toggle
seed_data_creation: Test categories and policies created/deleted during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A-D features fully tested. Categories at /api/categories (public) and /api/categories/admin/* (admin). Policies at /api/policies (public) and /api/policies/admin/* (admin). Admin panels accessible via sidebar: Categories and Policies. Quick Add button appears on hover over product cards. Footer has trust signals and policy links. Contact page at /contact. Policy pages at /policy/{slug}.

backend_categories_api.test: GET /api/categories returns list with name, slug, show_in_nav, sub_categories

frontend_header_nav.test: Header shows dynamic category navigation from API
Categories: SHOP ALL, TEST_CATEGORY, WEDGE HEELS, DRESSES, PLATFORM BOOTS visible

frontend_products_page.test: Category filter reads from URL query params (?category=Platform+Boots)
Quick Add button visible on product card hover

frontend_policy_page.test: Policy content rendered with markdown formatting
Other policy links shown at bottom

frontend_footer.test: Trust signals bar (Secure Payments, COD, Easy Returns, Fast Delivery)

frontend_product_detail.test: Product detail page loads with data-testid='product-detail-page'
Scarcity indicators conditional (low stock, limited, selling fast)

frontend_admin_policies.test: Policy list with slug, updated date, published status
Edit and delete buttons for each policy

bug_fixed.fix: Changed check_permission(admin, 'settings', 'edit') to check_permission(admin, 'platform_settings', 'edit') in create_policy, update_policy, and delete_policy functions
